quote: Something is wrong with the acoustics in Steamvent Alley. Conversations carry. Not echo — carry. You can hear someone whisper three blocks away as though they are standing behind you. But only certain words. Only the ones that matter.
source: Noise complaint investigation, GLMZ Housing Authority
context: Selective sound propagation in the GLMZ has been documented in at least six neighborhoods. The mechanism preferentially transmits emotionally significant speech.
